title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Apple XL 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid - 10mg
description: Apple XL from Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN collection brings an unparalleled Apple flavour experience. Bursting with bold, juicy notes, this classic fruit flavour is both intensely sweet and refreshingly light, reminiscent of biting into a crisp apple. This e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend provides an excellent balance of flavour and vapour production, while the nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth and satisfying throat hit. Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN e-liquids are ideal for use with starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike traditional freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts feature an alkaline formulation that allows for higher nicotine concentrations without the harsh throat hit. Nicotine salt e-liquids offer quicker nicotine absorption, providing rapid relief from cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a top choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers who need immediate and satisfying nicotine delivery. BAR EDTN is a curated collection of nic salt e-liquids inspired by Riot Squad’s popular disposable Riot Bar flavours. Just like the Riot Bars, Bar EDTN keeps the flavours straightforward, sweet, and consistently satisfying, so you always know what to expect. Enjoy this Apple XL flavour and explore the rest of Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN range, including the refreshing Watermelon Ice, classic Cherry Cola, and smooth Mango Vanilla. Whatever your preference, BAR EDTN has a flavour to suit your taste.
